lines.en: Boxing matches were very popular in England two hundred years ago.
lines.zh: 两百年前，拳击比赛在英国非常盛行。

lines.en: In those days, boxers fought with bare fists for prize money.
lines.zh: 当时，拳击手们不戴手套，为争夺奖金而搏斗。

lines.en: Because of this, they were known as 'prizefighters'.
lines.zh: 因此，他们被称作“职业拳击手”。

lines.en: However, boxing was very crude, for these were no rules and a prizefighter could be seriously injured or even killed during a match.
lines.zh: 不过，拳击是十分野蛮的，因为当时没有任何比赛规则，职业拳击手有可能在比赛中受重伤，甚至丧命。

lines.en: One of the most colourful figures in boxing history was Daniel Mendoza, who was born in 1764.
lines.zh: 拳击史上最引人注目的人物之一是丹尼尔。

lines.en: The use of gloves was not introduced until 1860, when the Marquis of Queensberry drew up the first set of rules.
lines.zh: 门多萨，他生于1764年。1860年昆斯伯里侯爵第一次为拳击比赛制定了规则，拳击比赛这才用上了手套。

lines.en: Though he was technically a prizefighter, Mendoza did much to change crude prizefighting into a sport, for he brought science to the game.
lines.zh: 虽然门多萨严格来讲不过是个职业拳击手，但在把这种粗野的拳击变成一种体育运动方面，他作出了重大贡献。

lines.en: In this day, Mendoza enjoyed tremendous popularity.
lines.zh: 是他把科学引进了这项运动。

lines.en: He was adored by rich and poor alike.
lines.zh: 门多萨在的全盛时期深受大家欢迎，无论是富人还是穷人都对他祟拜备至。

lines.en: Mendoza rose to fame swiftly after a boxing match when he was only fourteen years old.
lines.zh: 门多萨在14岁时参加一场拳击赛后一举成名。

lines.en: This attracted the attention of Richard Humphries who was then the most eminent boxer in England.
lines.zh: 这引起当时英国拳坛名将理查德。

lines.en: He offered to train Mendoza and his young pupil was quick to learn.
lines.zh: 汉弗莱斯的注意。

lines.en: In fact, Mendoza soon became so successful that Humphries turned against him.
lines.zh: 他主动提出教授门多萨，而年少的门多萨一学就会。

lines.en: The two men quarrelled bitterly and it was clear that the argument could only be settled by a fight.
lines.zh: 事实上，门多萨不久便名声大振，致使汉弗莱斯与他反目为敌。

lines.en: A match was held at Stilton, where both men fought for an hour.
lines.zh: 两个人争吵不休，显而易见，只有较量一番才能解决问题。

lines.en: The public bet a great deal of money on Mendoza, but he was defeated.
lines.zh: 于是两人在斯蒂尔顿设下赛场，厮打了一个小时。

lines.en: Mendoza met Humphries in the ring on a later occasion and he lost for a second time.
lines.zh: 公众把大笔赌注下到了门多萨身上，但他却输了。

lines.en: It was not until his third match in 1790 that he finally beat Humphries and became Champion of England.
lines.zh: 后来，门多萨与汉弗莱斯再次在拳击场上较量，门多萨又输了一场。

lines.en: Meanwhile, he founded a highly successful Academy and even Lord Byron became one of his pupils.
lines.zh: 直到1790年他们第3次对垒，门多萨才终于击败汉弗莱斯，成了全英拳击冠军。

lines.en: He earned enormous sums of money and was paid as much as $100 for a single appear one of his pupils.
lines.zh: 同时，他建立了一所拳击学校，办得很成功，连拜伦勋爵也成了他的学生。

lines.en: He earned enormous sums of money and was paid as much as $100 for a single appearance.
lines.zh: 门多萨挣来大笔大笔的钱，一次出场费就多可达100英镑。

lines.en: Despite this, he was so extravagant that he was always in debt.
lines.zh: 尽管收入不少，但他挥霍无度，经常债台高筑。

lines.en: After he was defeated by a boxer called Gentleman Jackson, he was quickly forgotten.
lines.zh: 他在被一个叫杰克逊绅士的拳击手击败后很快被遗忘。

lines.en: He was sent to prison for failing to pay his debts and died in poverty in 1836.
lines.zh: 他因无力还债而被捕入狱，最后于1836年在贫困中死去。

question.en: How many unsuccessful attempts did Mendoza make before becoming Champion of all England?
